40022765.author: पदार्थः
40022765.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, किम्पुरुषोत्पत्तिं the origin of the Kimpurushas, लक्ष्मणो Lakshmana, भरतस्तदा and Bharata then, आश्चर्यमिति "this is wonderful" thus, च and, अब्रूताम् they both said, उभौ both, रामं to Rama, जनेश्वरम् the lord of people.

40022765.author: Translation
40022765.content: Having heard the origin of the Kimpurushas, Lakshmana and Bharata then both exclaimed "This is wonderful!" to Rama, the lord of people.

40022766.author: पदार्थः
40022766.content: अथ then, रामः Rama, कथामेतां this story, भूय again, एव indeed, महायशाः the greatly renowned, कथयामास narrated, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled, प्रजापतिसुतस्य of the son of Prajapati, वै indeed.

40022766.author: Translation
40022766.content: Then, the greatly renowned and righteous-souled Rama indeed narrated this story again, concerning the son of Prajapati.

40022767.author: पदार्थः
40022767.content: सर्वास्ताः all of them, विद्रुताः having fled, दृष्ट्वा having seen, किन्नरीः the Kinnaris, ऋषिसत्तमः the best among sages (Budha), उवाच spoke, रूपसम्पन्नाम् endowed with beauty, ताम् that, स्त्रियम् woman, प्रहसन् इव as if laughing.

40022767.author: Translation
40022767.content: Seeing all the Kinnaris flee, the best among sages, Budha, spoke to that beautiful woman as if laughing.

40022768.author: पदार्थः
40022768.content: सोमस्य of Soma, अहम् I, सुदयितः very beloved, सुतः son, सुरुचिरानने O one with a very beautiful face, भजस्व love, माम् me, वरारोहे O beautiful woman, भक्त्या with devotion, स्निग्धेन with loving, चक्षुषा eyes.

40022768.author: Translation
40022768.content: Budha declared himself to be the beloved son of Soma and urged the beautiful woman to love him with devoted and tender eyes.

40022769.author: पदार्थः
40022769.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, शून्ये in the desolate place, स्वजनवर्जिते devoid of her own people, इला Ila, सुरुचिरप्रख्यम् to the very radiant one, प्रत्युवाच replied, महाग्रहम् to the great planet (Budha).

40022769.author: Translation
40022769.content: Hearing his words in that desolate place, devoid of her own people, Ila replied to the radiant Budha, the great planet.

40022770.author: पदार्थः
40022770.content: अहम् I, कामचरी moving at will, सौम्य O gentle one, तव your, अस्मि am, वशवर्तिनी obedient, प्रशाधि command, माम् me, सोमसुत O son of Soma, यथा as, इच्छसि you wish, तथा so, कुरु do.

40022770.author: Translation
40022770.content: Ila declared herself to be free-willed but now submissive to him, asking the gentle son of Soma to command her and do as he pleased.

40022771.author: पदार्थः
40022771.content: तस्याः her, तत् that, अद्भुतप्रख्यम् wonderful (speech), श्रुत्वा having heard, हर्षम् joy, उपागतः attained, सः he, वै indeed, कामी desirous, सह with, तया her, रेमे enjoyed, चन्द्रमसः of the Moon, सुतः son.

40022771.author: Translation
40022771.content: Hearing her wonderful words, the son of the Moon, filled with desire, indeed rejoiced and enjoyed himself with her.

40022772.author: पदार्थः
40022772.content: बुधस्य of Budha, माधवः Madhava, मासः month, तामिलाम् Tamila, रुचिराननाम् with a beautiful face, गतः passed, रमयतः while enjoying, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, क्षणवत् like a moment, तस्य for him, कामिनः the lustful one.

40022772.author: Translation
40022772.content: For Budha, the lustful one, the month of Madhava passed like a moment while he was exceedingly enjoying with Tamila of the beautiful face.

40022773.author: पदार्थः
40022773.content: अथ Then, मासे when the month, तु indeed, सम्पूर्णे was complete, पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननः whose face was like the full moon, प्रजापतिसुतः the son of Prajapati, श्रीमान् the glorious one, शयने on his bed, प्रत्यबुध्यत awoke.

40022773.author: Translation
40022773.content: Then, when the month was complete, the glorious son of Prajapati, whose face was like the full moon, awoke on his bed.

40022774.author: पदार्थः
40022774.content: सः He, अपश्यत् saw, सोमजम् the son of Soma, तत्र there, तपन्तम् performing penance, सलिलाशये in the water reservoir, ऊर्ध्वबाहुम् with raised arms, निरालम्बम् without support, तम् to him, राजा the king, प्रत्यभाषत spoke in return.

40022774.author: Translation
40022774.content: The king (Pururavas) saw Budha, the son of Soma, performing severe penance there in the water, with his arms raised and without support, and then the king spoke to him.

40022775.author: पदार्थः
40022775.content: भगवन् O venerable one!, पर्वतम् mountain, दुर्गम् difficult to access, प्रविष्टः entered, अस्मि I am, सहानुगः with my followers, न not, च and, पश्यामि I see, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, क्व where, नु indeed, ते those, मामकाः my people, गताः gone.

40022775.author: Translation
40022775.content: The king addressed Budha, saying, "O venerable one, I entered this difficult mountain with my followers, but I do not see my army; where have my people gone?"

40022776.author: पदार्थः
40022776.content: तत् That, श्रुत्वा having heard, तस्य his, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, नष्टसञ्ज्ञस्य whose consciousness was lost, भाषितम् speech, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, सान्त्वयन् consoling, परया with supreme, गिरा voice.

40022776.author: Translation
40022776.content: Having heard the bewildered words of that royal sage, Budha replied with auspicious words, consoling him with a supreme voice.

40022777.author: पदार्थः
40022777.content: अश्मवर्षेण by a shower of stones, महता great, भृत्याः servants, ते your, विनिपातिताः were killed, त्वं you, च and, आश्रमपदे in the hermitage, सुप्तः sleeping, वातवर्षभयार्दितः afflicted by the fear of wind and rain.

40022777.author: Translation
40022777.content: Your servants were killed by a great shower of stones, and you were sleeping in the hermitage, afflicted by the fear of wind and rain.

40022778.author: पदार्थः
40022778.content: समाश्वसिहि be comforted, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, निर्भयः fearless, विगतज्वरः free from anxiety, फलमूलाशनः one who eats fruits and roots, वीर O hero, निवस reside, इह here, यथासुखम् as comfortably as possible.

40022778.author: Translation
40022778.content: Be comforted, may good fortune be with you; O hero, reside here fearlessly and free from anxiety, subsisting on fruits and roots as comfortably as you wish.

40022779.author: पदार्थः
40022779.content: सः that, राजा king, तेन by that, वाक्येन word, प्रत्याश्वस्तः reassured, महामतिः great-minded, प्रत्युवाच replied, ततः then, वाक्यं words, दीनः distressed, भृत्यक्षयात् due to the destruction of servants, भृशम् greatly.

40022779.author: Translation
40022779.content: That great-minded king, though reassured by those words, then replied with great distress due to the loss of his servants.

40022780.author: पदार्थः
40022780.content: त्यक्ष्यामि I will abandon, अहं I, स्वकं my own, राज्यं kingdom, न not, अहं I, भृत्यैः by servants, विनाकृतः deprived of, वर्तयेयं I can live, क्षणं for a moment, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, समनुज्ञातुम् to permit, अर्हसि you ought.

40022780.author: Translation
40022780.content: O Brahmana, I will abandon my own kingdom, for I cannot live even for a moment without my servants; you ought to permit me to do so.

40022781.author: पदार्थः
40022781.content: सुतः son, धर्मपरः devoted to dharma, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, ज्येष्ठः eldest, मम my, महायशाः very famous, शशबिन्दुः Shashabindu, इति thus, ख्यातः known, सः he, मे my, राज्यं kingdom, प्रपत्स्यते will obtain.

40022781.author: Translation
40022781.content: O Brahmana, my eldest son, who is devoted to righteousness and very famous by the name Shashabindu, will succeed to my kingdom.

40022782.author: पदार्थः
40022782.content: न not, हि indeed, शक्ष्यामि I am able, अहं I, हित्वा having abandoned, भृत्यदारान् servants and wives, सुखान्वितान् comfortable, प्रतिवक्तुं to reply, महातेजः O greatly effulgent one, किञ्चिदपि even a little, अशुभं inauspicious, वचः word.

40022782.author: Translation
40022782.content: O greatly effulgent one, I am indeed unable to utter even a single inauspicious word in reply, having abandoned my comfortable servants and wives.

40022783.author: पदार्थः
40022783.content: तथा thus, ब्रुवति while speaking, राजेन्द्रे by the king of kings, बुधः Budha, परमम् exceedingly, अद्भुतम् wonderful, सान्त्वपूर्वम् consolingly, अथ then, उवाच spoke, वासः dwelling, त to you, इह here, रोचताम् may it be pleasing.

40022783.author: Translation
40022783.content: As the king of kings spoke thus, Budha, in an exceedingly wonderful and consoling manner, then said, "May your dwelling here be pleasing to you."

40022784.author: पदार्थः
40022784.content: न not, सन्तापः sorrow, त्वया by you, कार्यः to be caused, कार्दमेय O son of Kardama, महाबल O mighty one, संवत्सरोषितस्य of one who has resided for a year, इह here, कारयिष्यामि I shall cause to be done, ते for you, हितम् welfare.

40022784.author: Translation
40022784.content: O mighty son of Kardama, you should not feel any sorrow, for I shall ensure your well-being here after you have resided for a year.

40022785.author: पदार्थः
40022785.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, बुधस्य of Budha, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of untiring action, वासाय for dwelling, विदधे he resolved, बुद्धिं mind, यत् which, उक्तं was spoken, ब्रह्मवादिना by the speaker of Brahman.

40022785.author: Translation
40022785.content: Having heard that word from Budha, whose deeds were untiring and who spoke of Brahman, Ila resolved in his mind to dwell there as instructed.

40022786.author: पदार्थः
40022786.content: मासं for a month, स he, स्त्री a woman, तदा then, भूत्वा having become, रमयत्य he delighted, अनिशं constantly, शुदा happily, मासं for a month, पुरुषभावेन in the state of a man, धर्मबुद्धिं righteous intention, चकार he made, सः he.

40022786.author: Translation
40022786.content: For one month, he became a woman and constantly delighted happily, and for the next month, he assumed the state of a man and focused his mind on righteousness.

40022787.author: पदार्थः
40022787.content: ततः then, सा she, नवमे in the ninth, मासि month, इला Ila, सोमसुतात् from the son of Soma (Budha), सुतम् a son, जनयामास gave birth, सुश्रोणी (she) of beautiful hips, पुरूरवसम् Pururavas, ऊर्जितम् mighty.

40022787.author: Translation
40022787.content: Then, in the ninth month, Ila, who had beautiful hips, gave birth to a mighty son named Pururavas from Budha, the son of Soma.

40022788.author: पदार्थः
40022788.content: जातमात्रं as soon as born, तु indeed, सुश्रोणी (she) of beautiful hips (Ila), पितुः of the father, हस्ते in the hand, न्यवेशयत् placed, बुधस्य of Budha, समवर्णभम् having a similar complexion, इला Ila, पुत्रं the son, महाबलम् very powerful.

40022788.author: Translation
40022788.content: As soon as the very powerful son, who resembled Budha in complexion, was born, Ila of beautiful hips placed him in his father Budha's hand.

40022789.author: पदार्थः
40022789.content: बुधः Budha, तु but, पुरुषीभूतं having become a man (Ila), सः he, वै indeed, संवत्सरान्तरम् after a year, कथाभी with stories, रमयामास entertained, धर्मयुक्ताभिः righteous, आत्मवान् the wise one.

40022789.author: Translation
40022789.content: But the wise Budha, after a year, entertained Ila, who had become a man again, with righteous stories. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोननवतितमः सर्गः ।। 89 ।। Thus ends the eighty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
